title: What if the internet went down for 24 hours?
premise: The entire internet goes offline worldwide for exactly one day.

intro.title: What if the *internet* went down for 24 hours?
intro.subtitle: A HYPOTHETICAL SIMULATION

beats.caption: Billions of people are online. Then, at once, everything stops loading.
Card payments fail. Suddenly, only cash works.

tooltip.label: REAL EVENT
tooltip.text: In July 2024, one faulty software update crashed about 8.5 million computers and grounded flights worldwide.

beats.caption: Airlines can't check anyone in. Flights stay on the ground.
Hospitals switch to paper records and backup systems.

tooltip.label: SURPRISE
tooltip.text: GPS still works. It comes from satellites, not the internet. But many map apps can't load new maps.

beats.caption: Your phone still knows where you are. It just can't show you the way.
People start drifting outside. Parks fill up. Strangers actually talk.

banner.title: COST OF THE OUTAGE CLIMBS
banner.subtitle: Global trade frozen for nearly a full day

beats.caption: Online, trillions of dollars a day stop moving.
Then everything reconnects. And billions of notifications arrive at once.
